instruction: Force quit LibreOffice Writer from the terminal, then create /home/user/Desktop/done.txt containing the word 'terminated'.

result.command: PROC_STATUS=$(pgrep soffice >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "running" || echo "not_running"); FILE_PATH="/home/user/Desktop/done.txt"; if [ -f "$FILE_PATH" ]; then FILE_CONTENT=$(cat "$FILE_PATH" | head -1); else FILE_CONTENT=""; fi; echo "proc_status:$PROC_STATUS|file_content:$FILE_CONTENT"
